features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Single-Pass Printing Architecture
items.desc: The Rocket prints in a single continuous pass at industrial speed, eliminating multi-pass carriage movement and enabling output volumes that no scanning printer in its class can match.

items.title: Variable Ink Droplet Technology
items.desc: Piezoelectric printheads with 5, 7, and 12 picolitre variable droplet sizes deliver smooth gradients, sharp fine detail, and rich solid fills within the same print job.

items.title: Automated Printhead Cleaning Station
items.desc: Onboard self-cleaning system handles printhead maintenance automatically, extending head operational life and reducing manual intervention during long production shifts.

items.title: Adjustable Suction Platform
items.desc: Active suction across the print zone holds fabric flat and uniform throughout the pass, ensuring consistent ink placement accuracy regardless of fabric weight or surface texture.

items.title: Tension-Controlled Feeding and Winding
items.desc: Servo motors combined with laser-guided coil diameter sensors maintain precise, uniform fabric tension from unwind through winding, eliminating stretch and registration errors.

items.title: Auto Humidity and Surface Wiping System
items.desc: Automated humidity control and surface wiping maintain stable printhead performance throughout the run while reducing fabric defects and material waste.

items.title: Stable Ink Supply System with Degassing
items.desc: Peristaltic pump delivery with automatic negative pressure control and inline degassing ensures smooth, uninterrupted ink flow to all heads across extended high-speed production runs.

items.title: Industrial Inline Design
items.desc: Fabric entry, printing, drying, and collection are fully integrated into one automated inline system, removing manual handling between stages and maximising throughput efficiency.

items.title: Digital + Rotary Integration
items.desc: Integrates digital and rotary printing in one workflow, allowing for precise registration and special effects like gold, pearl, and puff.

items.title: Ink and Colour Efficiency
items.desc: Provides a 10–15% savings in ink consumption and a 15% improvement in colour performance.

items.title: Online Sizing
items.desc: Features Online Sizing for seamless front-to-back production, real-time quality control, and reduced waste and labour costs.

items.title: Fully Integrated In-Line Coating
items.desc: Allows for registered, design-based selective coating that saves paste costs and reduces wastewater impact.

items.title: Special Effect Overlays
items.desc: Supports complex special effect overlays such as gold, pearl, and puff, utilizing patented technology and precise camera registration.

items.title: Modular Hardware Design
items.desc: Includes distinct units for fabric infeed, dust removal/flattening, two rotary screens for online coating, digital printing, two rotary screens for foil/bloch printing, drying, and fabric outfeed.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Mass-Volume Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: The highest-output solution for large polyester fabric manufacturers supplying wholesale saree, dress material, and fashion textile markets where daily output volume is the primary business driver.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Continuous reactive printing on cotton at volumes suited to major export facilities supplying international brands requiring consistent quality across very large order quantities.

fabrics.title: Industrial Home Textile Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: High-capacity production of bedding, curtain fabric, upholstery, and decorative textiles at volumes that make traditional printing economics unviable for the required design variety.

fabrics.title: Commodity and Seasonal Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Single-pass speed makes the Rocket the most cost-effective choice for high-volume, low-design-change production runs where per-metre output cost is the critical business metric.

fabrics.title: Integrated Mills and Large Print Houses
fabrics.desc: Manufacturers operating dedicated printing divisions within vertically integrated facilities who need a machine that matches weaving and finishing line output capacities.

fabrics.title: Multi-Buyer Volume Job Work Operations
fabrics.desc: Large job work printing units with continuous order flow from multiple clients who need a machine that can print at scale without the speed limitations of scanning-head systems.

fabrics.title: Industrial-Scale Manufacturing and Transformation
fabrics.desc: High-speed single-pass production for large-scale digital and rotary hybrid textile printing.
